name: Global Shop Solutions ERP
description_en:
Global Shop Solutions provides manufacturing ERP connecting planning, shop-floor work, inventory, engineering and finance. Its job-costing documentation separates freight, labor, overhead, outside services, other and materials instead of treating a finished item as one unexplained cost.

Commercial terms distinguish concurrent users, shop-floor interfaces and deployment. This record is based on product, hosting and pricing pages; it did not run a shop, calculate production cost or verify cloud recovery.
description_zh:
Global Shop Solutions 提供连接规划、车间、库存、工程和财务的制造 ERP。工单成本资料区分运费、人工、间接费用、外部服务、其他及材料，而非把成品成本视为无法解释的单一金额。

商业条件区分并发用户、车间界面和部署方式。本文依据产品、托管及定价页，未运行工厂、计算生产成本或验证云恢复。

core_features.explanation_en: Job costing breaks inventory, WIP and cost of goods sold into named cost elements.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工单成本将库存、在制品及销货成本拆分为明确要素。

core_features.explanation_en: The page describes historical quantities/costs and absorbed-versus-actual overhead analysis.
core_features.explanation_zh: 页面介绍历史数量成本，以及已吸收与实际间接费用分析。

sections.title_en: Follow cost components from material to finished goods
sections.title_zh: 跟踪材料到成品的成本要素
sections.en:
The costing page uses FLOOOM for freight, labor, overhead, outside services, other and materials, with cost elements visible in inventory, WIP and COGS. It describes historical finished-goods quantities/costs and comparisons of absorbed versus actual overhead.

For a hypothetical fabricated part, trace purchased material, outsourced finishing and recorded labor into one completed job. Check whether freight or overhead is missing before trusting margin. This is a proposed acceptance case, not a verified costing implementation or financial recommendation.
sections.zh:
成本页用 FLOOOM 表示运费、人工、间接费用、外部服务、其他及材料，并在库存、在制和销货成本中保留要素；还介绍成品历史数量成本及间接费用吸收与实际对照。

可用一个假设加工件，追踪采购材料、外包表面处理和登记人工至完工工单，判断毛利前先查运费或间接费用是否漏记。这是建议验收，不是已验证的成本实施或财务建议。

sections.title_en: Price concurrent access and shop-floor interfaces separately
sections.title_zh: 分别核对并发访问与车间界面
sections.en:
The official pricing page read on 22 October 2026 describes a concurrent-user model based on employees in the system at once, with upfront and ongoing quarterly cost. It also lists graphical shop-floor interfaces with upfront and quarterly cost. Updates and support are included in the ongoing concurrent-user cost according to that page.

No numeric amount or currency was established. Request the required concurrent users, floor interfaces, modules, conversion and training in one proposal. Total employees are not automatically the concurrent count, and quarterly payment language should not be silently rewritten as a monthly subscription.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的官方定价页按同时使用系统的员工数提供并发用户模式，包含前期及持续季度费用；车间图形界面也列出前期及季度费用。页面说明并发用户持续费用包含更新与支持。

本次未确立数字金额或币种。方案中应写清并发用户、车间界面、模块、转换及培训，员工总数不自动等于并发数，也不能把季度付款擅自改写为月订阅。

sections.title_en: Choose a deployment with an explicit operating owner
sections.title_zh: 选择部署时明确运营负责人
sections.en:
The pricing page offers on-premise, cloud and SaaS arrangements. The cloud page describes virtual servers, vendor-managed maintenance, AWS and automatic backups; SaaS is described as vendor hosting and upkeep. These are delivery claims, not proof of a particular customer’s response time, compliance or restore success.

Compare who maintains infrastructure, upgrades, integrations and backup access for the quoted deployment. Ask for an export and a restore exercise in a separate environment before relying on recovery. Source-code rights and exact regional data location were not established.
sections.zh:
定价页列出本地、云和 SaaS 安排；云页面介绍虚拟服务器、厂商维护、AWS 及自动备份，SaaS 则由厂商托管维护。这些是交付描述，不能证明某客户的响应时间、合规或恢复成功。

应按报价部署比较谁维护基础设施、升级、集成和备份访问，并在依赖恢复前要求独立环境导出恢复演示。源码权利和具体地区数据位置未确立。

sections.title_en: Use a complete job and a late adjustment for acceptance
sections.title_zh: 用完整工单和迟到调整验收
sections.en:
Prepare item/BOM/routing data, opening stock/WIP, calendars, accounting balances and cost-allocation rules. Reconcile one job from input quantity to finished output and ledger cost, then examine a late outside-service invoice or backdated transaction in the historical cost view. These are evaluation suggestions.

The product is worth investigating for manufacturers needing connected shop and financial detail; it may exceed a simple bookkeeping requirement. No production scheduling, AI extraction, interface, migration, payroll/statutory coverage or performance was tested. Vendor claims of lower cost and optimal speed were not adopted as independent outcomes.
sections.zh:
应准备物品物料路线、期初库存在制、日历、账务余额及成本分摊规则，将一张工单从投入数量对到成品和总账成本，再在历史成本视图检查迟到外部服务发票或倒签交易。这些属于评估建议。

需要连接现场与财务明细的制造商可以调查；简单记账需求可能无需此范围。本文未测试排程、AI 提取、界面、迁移、薪资法定覆盖或性能，也未独立采用低成本或最佳速度主张。
